candidate: Only seed RGB membership changes, Array.includes to Set.has; source ordering, strict tie arithmetic and picked RGBs unchanged.
practicalTargets: Four licensed distinct sprites with shared Auto
High-entropy diagnostic input (cannot alone establish a practical win)
acceptance: Exact generated colors+all diagnostics over exact/binned/partial/GIF cohorts required. First-round promotion requires at least one practical whole-Auto target >=5% and >=3ms lower median, faster in >=4/5 paired trials; no cohort regresses by both >5% and >3ms (tiny cohorts >1ms absolute). Then actual app browser+Android worker/output/latency/CPU evidence is required before production. No production change from kernel timing alone.
limitation: Instrumented seed elapsed includes scheduler waits. Whole kernel elapsed includes source histogram and full fitting; neither includes browser import/worker/UI. No universal app acceptance threshold is inferred from this candidate gate.
